description: Land Aquisition - Kaluganga, Laggala Pallegama D/S Division, Matale District - Sec 39 (a) (1)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land acquisition and redemption matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifies the divestment of specific land allotments, provides detailed descriptions of land plots with boundaries and extents, and focuses entirely on land/property administration without involving government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or other specialized categories.
